snippet.title: 8 More Lives - First Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Lead a hardened company of outcast cat mercenaries through a gritty, low-magic fantasy land in this turn-based tactical RPG. Recruit, train, and equip your soldiers of fortune — each with unique traits and scars from past battles. Carve out your reputation among rival warbands, tyrannical barons, and night horrors — every decision in battle matters. Forge your story in a procedurally generated open world campaign.

-----

Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/pxQcmTF5NQ
Download Demo: https://ludenio.itch.io/8morelives
